scripts.verify:release: npm run test:local-intelligence && npm run test:supabase-migrations && node scripts/verify-release.cjs
scripts.build:web: esbuild web/native-app.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=web/native-app.bundle.js && esbuild web/intent-launcher.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=web/intent-launcher.bundle.js && esbuild web/supabase-client.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=web/supabase-client.bundle.js
scripts.test:supabase-migrations: node --test tests/supabase-migrations.test.mjs > /tmp/athlys-migrations-tests.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/athlys-migrations-tests.log; exit 1; }; cat /tmp/athlys-migrations-tests.log; grep -Eq '(^# tests 7$|^ℹ tests 7$)' /tmp/athlys-migrations-tests.log; grep -Eq '(^# pass 7$|^ℹ pass 7$)' /tmp/athlys-migrations-tests.log; grep -Eq '(^# fail 0$|^ℹ fail 0$)' /tmp/athlys-migrations-tests.log
